description: A single-use cryptographic seal bound to an attestation or proof id: the holder can present it exactly once, and a second presentation is refused (ProofOfSealRedemption 30119). Called with a delegation_token and deliverable_sha256 from a recorded delegation, it instead seals that deliverable hash into the delegation chain (AgentDeliverySeal). (x402: $0.05 USDC per call)
name: attestation.single-use-seal
